headline: 'Record-breaking results,' yet feeling betrayed… 'Watch out for Samsung Electronics volatility' [Investment 360]
summary: Samsung Electronics' third-quarter earnings, semiconductor ETF rebalancing, the end of share buybacks and options expiry coincided on the 8th. Forecasts suggest the stock price could become highly volatile.
why: Samsung Electronics is a South Korean conglomerate and one of the world's largest memory chip and smartphone makers, making it a bellwether for the chip cycle.

impacts.name: Samsung Electronics
impacts.why: Quarterly results, buyback termination and ETF rebalancing are expected to drive share price swings.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Third-quarter results were reported alongside the end of share buybacks, semiconductor ETF rebalancing and options expiry, which together were expected to make the stock volatile.
